title: Circuit for one output
statement: Given a multi-output directed acyclic Boolean circuit with $n$ inputs and an ordered list of output vertices, an index $i$ smaller than the number of outputs determines a single-output circuit with the same gates and with the $i$th output vertex as its output.
hypotheses_covered: The output index $i$ is a natural number.
The index $i$ is smaller than the number of output vertices.
